How did the turns play out for AZ in this instance?  

edit: I'm curious on it just because maybe I'm playing him wrong or haven't used some cards in the right way.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
First turn play was Cold Snap.

Second turn Cold Snap dealt damage to 1 damage to all non-hero targets. Played Focused Appertures.

Third Cold snap dealt 2 damage to all non-hero targets. Played Impale on Dawn.

Fourth and Fifth I am a little unsure of, but they consisted of playing another Impale and Hoarfire. So Dawn atleast took 5 each turn. She also took 3 from Hoarfire, the 2 was dealt to Autumn.

On the Sixth, Dawn took a total of 8 at the start, with all other non-hero targets taking 2. The card played was Thermal Shockwave.

Finally on the Seventh round, she still took 8 at the start, with all other non-hero targets taking the 2. With the play being Frostbound Drain dealing her 4 for the kill... So actually I guess Absolute Zero didn't deal himself any damage with Frostbound Drain.
